response.original_title: Hollywood Legends: Marilyn Monroe & Katharine Hepburn
response.overview: A Madacy Entertainment video release pairing two short biographical documentaries produced by North Shore Entertainment and Liberty International Entertainment: "Marilyn Monroe: A Life Story" and "Katharine Hepburn: Leading Lady". Each runs roughly 22 minutes and traces its subject's career through archive footage and film clips.
response.title: Hollywood Legends: Marilyn Monroe & Katharine Hepburn
